author: claude
title: Offline: flight partly outside its site cannot be saved

requirement.text:
Flights crossing the site boundary
Create a flight which is partially inside the site area and partially outside
 It’s only possible to save flights that are inside the site’s boundary
Create a flight which is fully outside the site area
 Same as above
For an existing site with downloaded tiles, create a flight plan outside the site. Then modify the site area so it covers the flight. Do we support this?
V: These are separate operations: creating a flight outside of the site boundary is possible offline, modifying a site triggers its map to update. 
Create a flight which is inside the site area. Then save, edit and move the flight outside the site area.

parts.text: Own QA_ site with Enable offline use at creation, downloaded
parts.quote: Enable offline use through site creation

parts.text: Flight with its area partly outside the site, take-off inside
parts.quote: Create a flight which is partially inside the site area and partially outside

parts.text: Offline: Save & exit disabled, outside-site warning shown
parts.quote: It’s only possible to save flights that are inside the site’s boundary

expected: Offline, Flight overview of a QA_ flight whose area is partly outside its downloaded site shows 'Flight elements outside of site boundaries' and Save & exit is disabled.

preconditions.text: tablet online at start (the case switches Wi-Fi off itself)

test_data.new_site: QA_{target} Boundary partly {time} in the qa-stag account (stays there)

cloud_writes.what: creates the site (stays in the account) and its offline map download to the tablet
creates the flight QA_{target} Partly outside (stays there; its plan is never saved)
the planner's Save only opens Flight overview; the case closes it with X, nothing is saved

forbidden: Save & exit or any other save
Delete or archive (the QA_ site and flight stay)
any site other than the one this case creates

routing.symbol: default site box 395x240 px at SITE_LOCATION_ZOOM 14
tabletZoom 15: the planner opens centred on the site

steps_note: Written 2026-11-11 from New test W-20261111-001. Geometry from source: the default site box is 395x240 CSS px at zoom 14 (about 1.28 x 0.78 km at 47.35 N); the planner opens at zoom 15 centred on the site, so the site spans about x 0.19-0.81 of the map on TA5 and 0.22-0.78 on ET65. The area is drawn online in the left band, then Wi-Fi off, then Save opens Flight overview. map-tap has not run on a device before this case. If the drawn area lands inside the site, the check fails for a test reason; the result screenshot shows where it landed.

steps.text: Leave a flight setup's 'Do you want to exit?' dialog when one is open (Exit; writes nothing)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap text:Exit --expect "js:!/Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 20

steps.text: Stop when the planner shows a flight that is not Hover's own (name not starting with QA_): a person's flight is never left or dropped; close it by hand, then run again
Top bar: Sites (a planner or a flight setup left open asks first)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving|Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20

steps.text: Exit without saving, when the planner asks (writes nothing)
Exit, when a flight setup asks 'Do you want to exit?' (writes nothing)
New site (opens site creation with the name field)
Site name: QA_{target} Boundary partly {time}
Location: type the lat/long 47.352000, 8.491000
Pick the lat/long suggestion: the map centres there at zoom 14 and the default site area is set
Turn on Enable offline use
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Enable offline use" --expect "js:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')].some(e => { let p = e; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && p; i++) { if (/Enable offline use/.test(p.innerText || '')) return e.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'; p = p.parentElement; } return false; })" --timeout 15

steps.text: Next (storage check; goes to the coordinate system step)
Save new site: creates the QA_ site (cloud write) and starts its offline download
Wait for 'Site available offline' (up to 5 min)
steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:/Site available offline|Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 300

steps.text: Create flight (opens the New flight form)
Flight name: QA_{target} Partly outside
Create: creates the QA_ flight in the new site (cloud write) and opens its planner
Wait until the empty planner is loaded
steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "text:Create area and take-off point" --timeout 60

steps.text: Area tool on
Area corner 1 at 0.12, 0.4 of the map
Area corner 2 at 0.34, 0.4
Area corner 3 at 0.34, 0.56
Area corner 4 at 0.12, 0.56, finished (row A1 - Area)
Take-off tool on
Take-off at 0.4, 0.48 (row T - Take off)
Wi-Fi off on the tablet; wait until the app shows it is offline
Save (planner): opens Flight overview for the QA_ flight (writes nothing itself)
Wait until Flight overview has finished its mission checks (Save & exit shows its label)
Screenshot: Flight overview offline
Check: offline, the outside-site warning shows and Save & exit is disabled
steps.read_js: ({offline: !navigator.onLine, warning: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] *')].some(e => (e.innerText || '').trim() === 'Flight elements outside of site boundaries' && e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0), save_exit_disabled: !!(document.querySelector('[data-testid=btn-save-and-exit]') || {}).disabled})

steps.text: Clean-up: close Flight overview without saving (X; only when it is open)
Clean-up: leave the planner (always; a planner showing a flight that is not Hover's own stays as it is)
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving|Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20

steps.text: Exit without saving when asked (always; writes nothing; only for Hover's own flight)
Exit when a flight setup asks 'Do you want to exit?' (always; writes nothing)
Clean-up: Wi-Fi back on (always)
